investigation.summary: How O3DE 26.05's Atom renderer lights a frame, ported to WGSL pass by pass and followed through the source: the depth pre-pass and tiled light culling, the sun's cascaded shadows and the screen-space shadow buffer, the forward pass and its five targets, the surface and the BRDF of the lighting models, multiscatter compensation, the global skylight and reflection probes, SSAO, transmission, and terrain.

controls.cubemap_hint: What a probe's bake stores: six 90-degree faces rendered from the probe's position, prefiltered into six mips (GGX, mip = roughness × 5). The cross unfolds them; the mirror ball (O3DE's visualization sphere: white, metallic, roughness 0) reflects them.
formula.decals: {@ formula="\begin{aligned}a &= \lit{1}{\alpha\cdot\mathrm{opacity}\cdot\mathrm{lerp}(1,\ s,\ k)}\\[3pt]s &= \lit{1}{\mathrm{smoothstep}(0.55,\ 1,\ N_v{\cdot}z)}\\[3pt]\mathrm{albedo} &\leftarrow \lit{2}{\mathrm{lerp}(\mathrm{albedo},\ b,\ a)}\\[3pt]b &= c\,f\,\mathrm{base}\\[3pt]N &\leftarrow \lit{3}{\mathrm{norm}\,\mathrm{lerp}(N,\ N_{\mathrm{map}},\ a_n)}\end{aligned}" display=yes colors="#64dfd1,#8fe3a0,#6be3b0"}
formula.reflections: {@ formula="\begin{aligned}w_i &= \lit{1}{1 \text{ in inner}_i,\ \text{else } \ell_i}\\[3pt]W &= \lit{1}{\textstyle\sum_i w_i}\\[3pt]R &= \lit{2}{(1-\min(W,1))\,G}\\[3pt]&\quad+\lit{3}{\textstyle\sum_i P_i\,w_i\,/\max(1,W)}\\[3pt]R_{\text{inner}} &= \lit{3}{P_{\text{last}}}\end{aligned}" display=yes colors="#64dfd1,#ffd98a,#ff6fb5"}
formula.ssao: {@ formula="\begin{aligned}w_k &= \lit{1}{1\,/\,(|o_k-p|^2+0.07)}\\[3pt]\mathrm{AO} &= \lit{1}{\textstyle\sum_k w_k\,\mathrm{sat}(n\cdot\hat d_k)\,/\sum_k w_k}\\[3pt]v &= \lit{2}{(1-\mathrm{AO}\cdot s)^{2.2}},\ \ 52\ \text{samples}\\[3pt]L_d &\leftarrow \lit{3}{L_d\cdot \mathrm{up}(\mathrm{blur}(v))}\end{aligned}" display=yes colors="#64dfd1,#ffd98a,#8fe3a0"}

help.lightIntensity: Intensity of the point light in candelas (m_rgbIntensityCandelas), applied over the light colour.
help.attenuationRadius: Attenuation radius of the point light in metres; the light fades to zero at this distance (m_invAttenuationRadiusSquared = 1 / r^2).
help.lightChannels: Lighting-channel mask of the point light (the editor default is all five channels, 0x1F). Only meshes sharing a channel are lit.
help.sphereLightingChannels: Lighting-channel mask of the sphere mesh (0x1F by default). It decides which lights can light the sphere.
help.extraLights: Number of extra simple point lights spread over the room, used to demonstrate light culling (0 to 48).
help.extraLightRadius: Attenuation radius of the extra point lights, in metres.
help.extraLightIntensity: Intensity of the extra point lights, in candelas.
help.extraLightMotion: How far the extra lights have moved, in degrees. Each height's ring turns about the room centre, the three at different rates and directions.
help.lightMarkers: Show a marker on each extra light. With cull tile on, the lights kept by the inspected point's bin are ringed and joined to the point.
help.cullTile: Show the inspected point's 16 x 16 tile: its view-space box, its depth bins, and the lights its bin keeps.
help.splitView: Split the scene area in two: the left shows the same camera in the left view mode, the right shows the frame in the current view mode.
help.splitViewMode: View mode shown in the left half of the split view, as an index of ViewMode (12 shows the lights in each pixel's tile and bin).
help.decals: Show two decals on the floor beside the sphere: a paint splat and a panel grid.
help.decalOpacity: Opacity of the decals (m_opacity, the component's Opacity).
help.decalNormalOpacity: How strongly the decals' normal maps apply (m_normalMapOpacity).
help.decalAngleAttenuation: How quickly decals fade as the surface turns away from the projection axis (m_angleAttenuation, the component's Attenuation Angle).
help.decalSplatSortKey: Sort key of the splat decal; the grid keeps the default 16, and larger keys draw on top.
help.decalTilt: Tilt of the splat about x in degrees: the angle between its projection axis and the floor normal.
help.decalTurn: Turn of the panel grid decal about the vertical axis, in degrees.
help.decalBoxes: Show the decals' boxes and projection axes.
help.sphereLight: Add an O3DE point light as a sphere area light, without shadows (simple point lights do no back lighting).
help.sphereLightX: Position x of the sphere light, in metres.
help.sphereLightY: Position y of the sphere light, in metres.
help.sphereLightZ: Position z of the sphere light, in metres.
help.sphereLightIntensity: Intensity of the sphere light, in candelas.
help.sphereLightRadius: Attenuation radius of the sphere light, in metres.
help.sphereLightBulb: Bulb radius of the sphere light in metres (the editor's default sphere shape is 0.05 m); it sets the size of the highlight.
help.ssao: Turn screen-space ambient occlusion (SSAO) on or off; it is on by default in the main pipeline.
help.ssaoStrength: SSAO strength (DefaultSsaoStrength is 1). Higher values darken occluded areas more.
help.ssaoRadius: SSAO sampling radius as a fraction of the half-resolution height (DefaultSsaoSamplingRadius is 0.05).
help.ssaoBlur: Turn the SSAO's depth-aware blur on or off.
help.ssaoBlurConstFalloff: Constant falloff of the SSAO blur (2/3 without an AO component; the component's default is 0.85).
help.ssaoBlurDepthThreshold: Depth falloff threshold of the SSAO blur (default 0).
help.ssaoBlurDepthStrength: Depth falloff strength of the SSAO blur (50 without an AO component; the component's default is 200).
help.probes: Show two reflection probes in the room, with cubemaps baked from the room demonstration's start.
help.probeParallax: Turn the probes' parallax correction on or off (on by default in the component).
help.probeInnerScale: The probes' inner extents as a fraction of the placed ones (clamped to the outer extents).
help.probeExposure: Render exposure of the probes, in stops (default 0).
help.probeBoxes: Show the probes' outer and inner boxes.

help.probeBakeFaces: How many of the cross's six faces are baked, in the cubemap's face order +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z.

help.clearCoatRoughness: ClearCoat.roughness of the clear coat layer, linear (0 by default).
help.sphereOcclusion: Assign the sphere's diffuse AO and specular cavity maps (1) or not (0, O3DE's default: no texture, occlusion 1).

pass.o3dePrepassFS: Draws the scene's depth only, with the forward pass's dithered coverage for fading objects, so light culling and shading see the frame's depth first.
pass.o3deLightCullingTilePrepareCS: For each 16 x 16 pixel tile, finds the nearest and farthest surface depth and marks which of 32 depth slices hold samples. Writes them to tileData.
pass.o3deLightCullingCS: For each tile, tests every light's sphere against the tile's depth box and its depth slices, and writes the indices of the lights that touch it into a per-tile light list.
pass.o3deLightCullingRemapCS: Regroups each tile's light list by depth bin, so a pixel reads only the lights that reach its own depth. Writes lightListRemapped and the worst bin's count.
pass.o3deLinearDepthCS: Converts the depth buffer's reversed-Z values into distance from the camera along the view axis, one value per pixel, for the shadow blur, AO and upsample.
pass.o3deFullscreenShadowCS: Rebuilds each pixel's world position from depth, looks it up in the sun's cascaded shadow maps, and writes 1 for lit or 0 for shadowed into shadowRaw.
pass.o3deShadowBlurVerticalCS: Blurs the raw shadow vertically, weighting neighbours by depth difference so shadows soften without bleeding across edges. A disabled blur copies its input.
pass.o3deShadowBlurHorizontalCS: Blurs the vertically blurred shadow horizontally with the same depth-aware weights. The result is the shadow buffer that the forward pass reads.
pass.o3deForwardFS: Lights each visible surface with its material (GGX specular, diffuse, lights from the culled list, sun shadow), writing diffuse, specular, albedo, F0 and normal targets.
pass.o3deDiffuseGlobalCS: Adds the sky's diffuse light: the albedo times the diffuse cubemap in the normal's direction, added onto the forward pass's diffuse result.
pass.o3deReflectionsCS: Computes image-based reflections from the global cubemap and any reflection probes, blended by probe volume, and writes them to a reflection target.
pass.o3deReflectionCompositeCS: Adds the reflection target onto the forward pass's specular target, only where the stencil marks a surface, giving the specular light with reflections.
pass.o3deDepthDownsampleCS: Shrinks the linear depth to half resolution by taking the upper-left pixel of each 2 x 2 block, giving the ambient-occlusion pass a cheaper depth to sample.
pass.o3deSsaoCS: At half resolution, rebuilds each pixel's position and normal from depth, samples nearby depths in a spiral, and estimates how occluded the pixel is from them.
pass.o3deSsaoBlurVerticalCS: Blurs the raw occlusion vertically, weighting neighbours by depth difference so the sampling noise smooths out without crossing edges.
pass.o3deSsaoBlurHorizontalCS: Blurs the vertically blurred occlusion horizontally with the same depth-aware weights, finishing the half-resolution ambient-occlusion buffer.
pass.o3deSsaoUpsampleCS: Enlarges the half-resolution occlusion to full size: each pixel blends its four nearest half-resolution texels, weighted by distance and by how close their depths are.
pass.o3deMergeCS: Adds diffuse (times the occlusion) and specular into the HDR image, averaging the MSAA samples and drawing the sky where nothing was drawn.
